subject: german
title: Kulturen vergleichen
welcome_lead: Comparing German-speaking cultures shows shared roots and local difference. Berlin vs Vienna vs Zurich.

walkthroughs.body_html: Both share the language but Austria is famed for Mozart, Strauss, Klimt; Germany for Bach, Beethoven, Goethe. Politics differ — Germany federal, Austria neutral.
Direct democracy, neutrality, multilingualism. Volksabstimmung (popular vote) shapes policy directly — unique among D-A-CH.
Use im Vergleich zu, im Unterschied zu, wahrend. Conclude with reflection on what comparison reveals.

mcqs.q: Why can you not just ignore umlauts in German?
options: They change the pronunciation AND meaning of words.
They are pronounced the same as without dots.
Accusative (because it sounds like a direct relationship).
